parameters.help_en: The specific custom cipher suites to add. This parameter is used only when CipherSuite is set to 99
parameters.help_zh: 要添加的具体自定义加密套件。仅CipherSuite配置为99时，使用该参数
parameters.name: custom_ciphers

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the WAF instance.
You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html to query the ID of the current WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例的ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html，查看当前WAF实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether TLS 1.3 is supported. Valid values:

true: TLS 1.3 is supported.

false: TLS 1.3 is not supported.
This parameter is used only when HttpsPorts is not empty, which indicates that the domain name uses the HTTPS protocol. When TLSVersion is set to tlsv1.3, this value must be true
parameters.help_zh:
是否支持TLS1.3版本。取值：

true：表示支持TLS1.3版本。

false：表示不支持TLS1.3版本。
仅HttpsPorts取值不为空（表示域名使用HTTPS协议）时，使用该参数。当TLSVersion为tlsv1.3时，此值必须为true
parameters.name: enable_tlsv3

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id
